name: contract-example-display
goal: Keep documented expectations for every selected helper case visible at its tested revision without borrowing sibling examples

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Explorer helperDocumentation returns helper.examples before standardized testing.examples, and revision hydration ignores contract examples when a Markdown path exists. Selected helpers therefore hide supported expected results and error examples.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Strengthen the existing revision documentation case and helper selection case with legacy Markdown, canonical authored results, sibling isolation and expected errors. Keep their declarations unchanged; no standalone regression suite.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At 1973fe8bc0 the same three documentation cases and six catalog cases execute. The existing revision case loses finish: Finish and the existing helper-selection case loses Null count. Retained proof 0ddb9828ffe20f78cad61a15336ed139cee85816d3a684c100861f858bcc2877 contains both product-caused assertion diffs; no added test declarations.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Hydration retains exact revision Markdown and appends its authored canonical Examples. Selected helpers combine only their own helper-contract and canonical expected results/errors. The viewer model carries the same testing contract. Observed execution results never replace authored comments.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
